title: DWG MTEXT rotation-only orientation
authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §20.4.46 defines the main MTEXT X-axis direction as a 3BD WCS vector. Existing DXF orientation provenance selects the last relevant group 11 or 50 and retains legacy API nonzero-vector priority.
problem: DWG MTEXT encoding always wrote secPoint, so a rotation-only input with angle=30 degrees and no explicit vector was written as zero direction; ODA readback displayed an unrotated 0-degree entity.
change: Reuse dxfOrientationForOutput. For its Rotation mode, or legacy callers with no nonzero direction, derive a temporary WCS unit direction from the angle in degrees and the existing normalized arbitrary-axis OCS basis. Keep explicit Direction and legacy nonzero-vector behavior unchanged and do not mutate caller fields. Rotation requiring a nonfinite angle or a zero/nonfinite extrusion is refused before encoding, allowing retry. The R2018 redundant column context remains independently represented.
source_provenance: ezdxf 1.4.5 authored rotation-only AC1021 DXF, converted by ODA File Converter 27.1 to AC1021 DWG and returned as AC1027 DXF. Separate tilt, negative-normal, nonunit-normal, and conflicting group 11/50 ordering inputs were authored locally. Hashes bind individual artifacts; conversion lineage is the recorded local run, not established by those hashes alone.
physical_results: LibreDWG 0.14 and ODA AC1027 DXF show source rotation 30° produces WCS axis (cos30,sin30,0) for +Z, (-cos30,0,sin30) for +Y, and (-cos30,sin30,0) for -Z. ODA normalizes the sampled +Y nonunit input. With +Y normal, direction (0,0,1) before rotation resolves to rotation; reversed order resolves to direction. Generated baseline axis is zero and ODA output has no direction with 0-degree rotation. Corrected generated output matches each source vector for +Z, +Y and -Z. All nine source/baseline/corrected DWG/DXF pairs pass the hash-bound independent audit. ODA produced no .err for the sampled runs.
generated_validation: Isolated six-version CTest passes for AC1015/18/21/24/27/32, with both DXF ordering inputs and copied objects with separately edited angle/direction, three sampled unit normals and a nonunit finite normal, legacy nonzero vector including nonunit 3D direction preservation, zero/nonfinite normal and NaN angle refusal and same-writer retry, caller field preservation and following LINE readback. Unmodified writer fails the --geometry-only control at AC1015 readback.
limits: Physical output evidence is limited to the three stated normals and one 30-degree rotation, using existing material and plotstyle graph opt-ins. No native application rendering or arbitrary profile is claimed. Binary DXF order parsing is covered by pre-existing DXF tests, not by this new ASCII-input control.
reproduction: Use tools/author_ac1021_mtext_rotation.py <new-directory> with ezdxf 1.4.5 to create equivalent source DXFs; timestamps and hashes may vary.
Convert each source DXF to ACAD2007 DWG, then to ACAD2013 DXF using ODA; audit exact hashed pairs with the command above.

Compile tools/probe_ac1021_mtext_rotation.cpp against the final library, defining MTEXT_NORMAL=0,1,2 for +Z,+Y,-Z, then invoke <producer> text <new-dwg>; convert each to ACAD2013 DXF and run the peer audit with --generated-graph.
integrated_validation: The updated six-version DWG orientation test and existing ASCII/Binary DXF orientation CLI tests passed 3/3.
